responsibility: Adapts the rs6000 SysV configuration to LynxOS. It replaces generic specs with LynxOS cpp, cc1, asm, and linker behavior, forces big-endian and AIX-style struct return compatibility, disables TLS and relocatable fixup assumptions that do not match LynxOS, and sets the corresponding predefined macros and DWARF numbering rules for this RTOS target.
